      Travel to Egypt

      Experience the Timeless Splendor and Warm Hospitality of the Arab Republic of Egypt with Saudia

      Uncover the magic of a land where thousands of years of history blend seamlessly with vibrant modern life. From the iconic Giza plateau to the tranquil banks of the Nile, Egypt invites you to immerse yourself in a culture defined by generosity and awe-inspiring heritage. Fly with Saudia to experience an elevated journey to the heart of the ancient world.


      1. Savor Authentic Koshari

      Taste the soul of Cairo in a bowl. This beloved national dish combines lentils, rice, and pasta topped with a zesty tomato sauce and crispy onions for a flavorful explosion.


      2. Sail The Nile On A Felucca

      Drift along the world’s longest river on a traditional wooden sailboat. Watch the sunset paint the sky as you enjoy the peaceful breeze and timeless river views.


      3. Explore Ancient Pyramids And Tombs

      Stand in the shadow of the Great Pyramid of Giza. Journey through the Valley of the Kings to witness the intricate carvings and vivid colors preserved within royal resting places.


      4. Feast On Traditional Street Food

      Discover a world of flavor at every corner. From steaming falafel and ful medames to sweet basbousa, Egyptian street food offers a delicious glimpse into local life.


      5. Join A Hands-On Cooking Class

      Master the secrets of Egyptian spices. Learn to prepare classic dishes from local chefs and bring the authentic taste of the Mediterranean home with you.


      6. Wander Through Historic Bazaars

      Navigate the shimmering alleys of Khan el-Khalili. Shop for hand-carved souvenirs, aromatic perfumes, and intricate lanterns in one of the world’s oldest shopping districts.


      7. Dive Into Red Sea Reefs

      Plunge into the crystal-clear waters of Sharm El Sheikh or Hurghada. Explore vibrant coral gardens and swim alongside exotic marine life in a world-class diving destination.


      8. Experience A Desert Safari Adventure

      Race across golden dunes in a 4x4 or enjoy a rhythmic camel trek. Spend a night under the stars in a Bedouin camp for an unforgettable desert experience.


      9. Watch A Traditional Folk Dance

      Be mesmerized by the spinning colors of a Tanoura performance. Feel the energy of the music as dancers tell stories through graceful, hypnotic movements.


      10. Sip Tea At A Local Cafe

      Relax like a local with a glass of hot mint tea. Soak in the lively atmosphere of a traditional ahwa and enjoy the warm spirit of Egyptian conversation.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Egypt

      1. Cairo

      Experience the heartbeat of Egypt in a city where ancient wonders meet modern energy. Marvel at the Great Pyramids of Giza, explore the vast treasures within the Egyptian Museum, and lose yourself in the vibrant colors and scents of the historic Khan el-Khalili bazaar.


      2. Alexandria

      Step into the "Mermaid of the Mediterranean" to discover a unique blend of Greco-Roman history and stunning coastal views. Walk along the scenic Corniche, visit the magnificent Bibliotheca Alexandrina, and explore the majestic Citadel of Qaitbay overlooking the turquoise sea.


      3. Sharm El Sheikh

      Dive into a world of adventure at this premier Red Sea resort destination. Immerse yourself in the crystal-clear waters of Ras Mohammed National Park to see world-class coral reefs, enjoy luxury relaxation on sun-drenched beaches, and embark on thrilling desert safaris under the stars.
